US Launches Strikes on Iran Amid Tensions in Strait of Hormuz

The United States has launched a new round of strikes against Iran, following Tehran's declaration that the Strait of Hormuz is closed. The move comes amid heightened tensions between the two countries. The strikes are believed to be in response to an attack on a US-flagged oil tanker, the M/V GFS Galaxy. The incident has raised concerns about the stability of the region and the potential for further conflict.
